title: NextGAN: Towards Simple and Scalable GAN Training for Image and Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adversarial training enables one- and few-step image and video generation, but conventional adversarial losses supervise critic values without directly specifying the gradients used to update the generator. We present NEXTGAN, which trains a scalar critic by regressing its input gradient onto displacements between independently paired reference and generated features at interpolated locations in frozen representation spaces. For a fixed generator, this regression is equivalent to an adversarial objective with a gradient-energy penalty, while the generator retains the standard potential-based GAN update. The same objective adapts pre-trained image and video generators with up to 14B parameters, without auxiliary losses, online teacher scores, or trajectories. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, NEXTGAN achieves one-step FIDs of 2.87 with pixel-space JiT-B and 1.54 with latent-space DiT-XL/1; its adversarial form further reaches 1.36. For text

translated_title: NextGAN：迈向简单且可扩展的图像与视频生成GAN训练
translated_abstract: 对抗训练能够实现单步和少步的图像与视频生成，但传统的对抗损失仅监督评论家的数值，并未直接规定用于更新生成器的梯度。我们提出了NEXTGAN，该方法通过在冻结的表示空间中，将标量评论家的输入梯度回归到独立配对的参考特征与生成特征之间在插值位置上的位移，从而训练该评论家。对于固定的生成器，这一回归等价于带有梯度能量惩罚的对抗目标，而生成器则保留标准的基于势函数的GAN更新。同一目标函数可以适配参数量高达14B的预训练图像和视频生成器，无需辅助损失、在线教师评分或轨迹。在ImageNet 256×256上，NEXTGAN在像素空间的JiT-B下取得了2.87的单步FID，在潜在空间的DiT-XL/1下取得了1.54；其对抗形式进一步达到1.36。
tldr: NEXTGAN提出通过将标量评论家的输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中配对特征间的位移来直接约束生成器的更新梯度，实现了简单且可扩展的GAN训练，无需辅助损失即可高效适配高达140亿参数的预训练图像与视频生成器，并取得先进的单步生成效果。
en_tdlr: NEXTGAN enables simple and scalable GAN training by regressing a scalar critic's input gradient onto displacements between independently paired reference and generated features in frozen representation spaces, adapting pre-trained image and video generators with up to 14B parameters without auxiliary losses for state-of-the-art one-step generation.
